hero.title: How multi-entity consolidation works
hero.lede: A plain-language look at how Intuit Enterprise Suite unifies every entity, eliminates intercompany noise, and closes the books faster.
overview.title: One platform, every entity, in real time
overview.body: Growing companies outgrow spreadsheets and disconnected ledgers long before they are ready for a legacy ERP. Intuit Enterprise Suite closes that gap with a single system that manages users, entities, locations, and subsidiaries from one sign-in.
caps.title: What it does under the hood
item-1.title: Single sign-in
item-1.body: Manage every entity, location, and subsidiary from one login without juggling separate files.
item-2.title: Automatic eliminations
item-2.body: Intercompany transactions reconcile and eliminate on their own, so consolidated numbers stay clean.
item-3.title: Consolidated reporting
item-3.body: Roll up performance across the business into one consolidated view, refreshed in real time.
item-4.title: Faster close
item-4.body: Automation trims the month-end close from weeks to days across all entities at once.
detail.title: From rearview reporting to real-time decisions
detail.body: Instead of stitching numbers together after the fact, finance leaders see the full picture as it happens. The result is fewer surprises, a shorter close, and more time for the analysis that actually moves the business.
quote.text: Unified 9 entities and cut accounting time by 50%.
cta.title: See how it maps to your business
cta.body: Talk to a migration specialist and find out if Intuit Enterprise Suite is the right move for your finance team.
